## Introduction
This is a brief demonstration of how DataSHIELD can be used to analyse an observational study
across several sites. The question is whether exposure to PFAS ('forever chemicals') is associated
with kidney cancer. Exposure is the serum PFAS concentration, and the outcome is kidney cancer
status. The three sites hold simulated data.

## Load packages
```{r packages}
library(dsBaseClient)
library(DSMolgenisArmadillo)
library(MolgenisArmadillo)
```

## Log in to servers using DataSHIELD
``` {r login}
url <- "http://localhost:8080"
credentials <- armadillo.get_credentials(url)

builder <- newDSLoginBuilder()
for (server in c("groningen", "amsterdam", "barcelona")) {
  builder$append(
    server  = server,
    url     = url,
    token   = credentials@access_token,
    driver  = "ArmadilloDriver",
    profile = "donkey"
  )
}

conns <- datashield.login(logins = builder$build())
```

## Load data
```{r assign}
datashield.assign.table(
  conns,
  symbol = "study",
  table  = list(
    groningen = "uncan/data/site_1",
    amsterdam = "uncan/data/site_2",
    barcelona = "uncan/data/site_3"
  )
)
```

## Check what data is available
```{r tables}
ds.dim("study")
ds.colnames("study")$groningen
```

## Visualise data
PFAS concentration on a log2 scale, at each site:
```{r histogram}
ds.histogram("study$log2_pfas", type = "split")
```

## Is PFAS associated with kidney cancer?
We fit a logistic model at each cohort, adjusted for age, sex, smoking and BMI, and combine the estimates:
```{r forest}
slma <- ds.glmSLMA(
  formula  = "kidney_cancer ~ log2_pfas + age + sex + smoking + bmi",
  family   = "binomial",
  dataName = "study"
)
two_stage <- metafor::rma(
  yi     = slma$betamatrix.valid["log2_pfas", ],
  sei    = slma$sematrix.valid["log2_pfas", ],
  method = "REML",
  slab   = names(conns)
)
metafor::forest(
  two_stage,
  header = c("Cohort", "Log odds of kidney cancer [95% CI]"),
  xlab   = "Log odds of kidney cancer per doubling of PFAS",
  mlab   = "Combined",
  col = "#4285F4", border = "#4285F4", psize = 1.2
)
```

## Log out
```{r logout}
datashield.logout(conns)
```
